summary: This document describes two methods for producing an integrity check value from a Diffie-Hellman key pair and one from an elliptic curve key pair. It is needed for tasks like signing a PKCS #10 certification request. The algorithms prove possession of the private key and are not a general-purpose signing algorithm. It obsoletes an earlier RFC.

eli5.summary: This shows how to prove you own a secret key without giving the key away, like showing you can open a lock without handing over the key.

questions: how to prove possession of a dh private key
